limit.description: The maximum number of albums to return

genre.description: The genre to filter artists by

filter.description: RSQL filter expression, e.g. `artist=="Daft Punk";year=ge=2000`. Supports ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, =in=, =out=, and `;`/`and`, `,`/`or` combinators, `*` wildcards in string values. Filterable fields: title, artist, year, releaseDate, sha256, uri, artistUri, createdAt

startDate.description: The earliest listening timestamp for album rankings (inclusive)

endDate.description: The latest listening timestamp for album rankings (inclusive)

sortBy.description: Rank albums by total plays or unique listeners. Defaults to plays.
